facts.text: Beginning in 2026, new first-year, full-time undergraduate students who reside in Harnett County have 100 percent of their tuition covered by Campbell University.

sources.title: Campbell to offer free tuition for Harnett County residents - News
sources.quote: New first-year, full-time students who reside in Harnett County will have 100 percent of their undergraduate tuition covered by Campbell University beginning in 2026, the University announced today.
